committed_scope.note: Frozen production remains schema136/v2_0037 and assetsv130. Concurrent UI/schema v0038 work was excluded and is not validated here.

root_cause: Five synthetic PyAV output producers closed only on successful completion. Python exceptions skipped explicit close, allowing the still-owned container to remain reachable through exception frames or other references. Strongly held real native containers show zero close calls at the failure boundary in the old helpers. Regression teardown itself always releases them.
changes: Put container.close in finally at all5 output sites without catch/suppression or successful return on failed cleanup
Retain original exception when close succeeds; expose close failure and preserve the original exception as context
Keep codecs, fps, dimensions, frame counts, AAC odd samples, long-video duration and existing assertions; prove the5 normalized successful AST paths are identical
Minor preexisting import-style/unused-name cleanup limited to touched test files
limits: Python finally cannot guarantee cleanup after abrupt native process termination
This does not identify the owner of system commit allocations or establish causes of older retrieval/ASR worker exits
No user service stopped, pagefile changed, production runtime/dependency/schema or foreground input changed

checks: close error visibility with body context
